name: File Gate Assurance
description: Gate file delivery behind a hardware-backed, phishing-resistant assurance level (PIV/CAC or FIDO2/WebAuthn) proven at any standards-compliant OIDC IdP. Provider-agnostic; DPoP (RFC 9449) sender-constraining is opt-in.

suggests.drupal/openid_connect: Optional: supplies a same-origin Drupal SSO access token for the plain-link session bridge.

project_description: File Gate Assurance adds an 'assurance' gate method that requires a hardware-backed, phishing-resistant assurance level (PIV/CAC — HSPD-12 / FIPS 201 — or FIDO2/WebAuthn) before a gated file is delivered, proven at any standards-compliant OIDC IdP or natively with File Gate as the WebAuthn relying party. It is provider-agnostic (OIDC discovery + JWKS): a field lists one or more trusted issuers, each with its own expected audience and accepted acr values, and a token is matched to exactly one issuer by its iss claim. The signing algorithm is pinned to the issuer's published JWKS (never the token header), defeating alg-confusion and 'none'/HMAC. DPoP (RFC 9449) sender-constraining and RFC 7662 introspection are opt-in. Verification can happen at redemption (live OIDC token, Model B), at mint (trust the stepped-up caller, Model A, optionally with A2 mint-time OIDC), via edge mTLS (a validated client-certificate subject from a trusted proxy header with a required allowlist), or via native WebAuthn. A short-lived HttpOnly session-bridge cookie lets the same signed URL download as a normal browser link after a successful step-up.
